title: Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest
question: Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest football player?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT t1.player_name
FROM Player AS t1
INNER JOIN player_skill_attributes AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
WHERE t1.player_api_id IN (
    (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY height ASC LIMIT 1)
)
GROUP BY t1.player_api_id, t1.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(t2.finishing) DESC
LIMIT 1

react.initial_search_query: Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest football player?

prefetched_grounding.provenance: deterministic read-only database probes; no model-authored claims

react.raw_react_sql:
SELECT t1.player_name
FROM Player AS t1
INNER JOIN player_basic_info AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
INNER JOIN player_skill_attributes AS t3 ON t2.id = t3.id
WHERE t1.player_api_id IN (
    (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE height IS NOT NULL ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE height IS NOT NULL ORDER BY height ASC LIMIT 1)
)
GROUP BY t1.player_api_id, t1.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(t3.finishing) DESC
LIMIT 1
